scope: National Assembly elections of 3 April 2022 and 12 April 2026, all 199 seats: votes and national list seats from the National Election Commission minutes, single-member district seats per list from the election office's composition pages (aggregate counts only). Constituency votes and per-district results, 2018 and earlier elections, and the results application's other figures are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner reply: publish national figures from the minutes only on Copyright Act § 1(4), recorded as a reading of the statute, weaker than a licence; no candidate names; the CSV is never republished.
Owner reply: one reading each of the 2026 and 2022 minutes, the 2026 CSV for a local cross-check only, and njt.hu registered for the statutes.
Owner reply: leave 2018 out for now.

Owner reply: extend the Copyright Act § 1(4) reading to the office's official composition pages for aggregate seat counts per election only, no candidate names; one reading by hand; the build fails unless list seats match the minutes and the tiers come to 93 + 106 = 199.

reuse_right.basis: Copyright Act § 1(4) excludes official notices and case documents, and Act XXXVI of 2013 § 76(2)(e) requires the National Election Office to publish the content of the result minutes as public-interest data. This is a reading accepted by the owner, weaker than a licence. The office's Impresszum is on a robots-blocked host and was not read, so it could contain conditions.

normalized_republication.basis: Same basis: national figures transcribed from the minutes, plus district seat counts per list from the composition pages. The database right in § 84/A was not settled; only a handful of aggregate counts per election are taken from the application, and its data and generated CSV are not republished.

raw_redistribution.basis: The PDFs and page images are not committed; they are identified by checksum. Pages naming candidates and committee members are not transcribed.

acquisition_route.basis: One request per named PDF on static.valasztas.hu, whose robots.txt allows all paths. www.valasztas.hu stays blocked and was not contacted. The composition pages on vtr.valasztas.hu (robots.txt allows all paths) were read once by hand in a browser on 2026-11-05 UTC; their data endpoints were not requested.

source_files_complete.basis: The minutes hold registers, participation, ballots, votes for every party and nationality list, surplus votes, thresholds, the preferential quota and national list seats. The composition pages hold list and district seats per nominating organisation for all 199 seats.

national_definition_complete.basis: Party-list and nationality-list votes reconcile separately to printed totals and together to valid ballots; registers, participation and ballots reconcile; printed thresholds and quotas reproduce; recomputing the highest-averages allocation gives the printed seats. Every composition row matches a list of the minutes with the same list seats, district seats total 106, list seats 93 and all seats 199; a nationality list holds no district seat. Constituency votes are not held.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list keeps its number, identifier and printed name. Joint lists stay one contestant; their votes and seats are not divided. Kinds rest on the printed name and the official application; for 2022 no official joint-list label was read. Nationality lists are a separate kind and ballot. No party register was reviewed.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Act CCIII of 2011 §§ 3, 13, 14 and 16 quoted in the evidence record, in the version served on the retrieval date; both sets of minutes apply the same thresholds and method.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: The commission's minutes are the result determination, and the official application shows each result as legally final with matching figures. Commission and Curia decision texts were not read.

continuity: None: no party register was reviewed, so no link is made between 2022 and 2026, even where a name repeats. continuous_party_series is 0.
